text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s08","problem":"The chat paragraph and the four suggestion chips show heavy red in the heatmap. The text is bolder than the real text. The chips run 1px wider (e.g. the first chip ends at ~280 vs ~278 on the real screen). The chip icons (tag, newspaper, calendar, sparkle) are drawn differently.","fix":"Set the paragraph font-weight to 400/500 to match the real thin strokes, with the same 1px baseline. Narrow each chip by 1-2px, so 'Watch a price, event or product' spans x16-278. Redraw the chip icons as 20px thin-stroke outlines, white, with 12px gap to the label. Shift the chip label text about 1px right and up."},{"element_id":"s08","problem":"The 'Ask Luzia' composer placeholder and the mic button are slightly off, with red rings around the box edge and the mic.","fix":"Place the placeholder 1px lower in the box. Keep the box at x8-403, y738-830 with a #262626-ish fill and 16px radius. Move the mic button 1px down. Use a plain white circle with a small black mic glyph."},{"element_id":"s11","problem":"The heading, disclaimer, prompt text and card titles are 1px higher than the real ones and heavier. The disclaimer wraps at slightly different offsets. The box border and mic button show red rings.","fix":"Move 'Start with an idea or remix.' down 1px and lighten it to weight 600. Move the disclaimer down 1px and set it to weight 400, centered with the same wrap ('...once' / 'published.'). Move the card titles and subtitles down 1px. Move the mic button down 1px and left 1px. Keep the prompt box at y107-306."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The hero circle icon (bell with sparkle) is slightly off, and the 'Let Luzia handle it!' heading and body text are heavier than the real text and 1px shifted.","fix":"Redraw the bell glyph inside the 96px circle at center (205,335) with a smaller sparkle at the top right. Set the heading to weight 600 and the body to weight 400, and check the line wrap. Do the same for the tab labels 'Chat', 'Services' and 'Create', and the pill 'Routines'."},{"element_id":"s09","problem":"The list row text and the button label are heavier than the real ones. The 'Draft' pill's pencil icon and the clock tile differ. The 'Add new Routine' button edge shows a red line at its top.","fix":"Set 'New routine', 'Draft' and 'Add new Routine' to weight 500. Redraw the pencil as a thin outline. Redraw the clock icon in the tile as thin white strokes. Move the button 1px down so its top is at y714, and move its label to y733."}],"summary":"All elements are within tolerance and all taps work, so the remaining loss is text weight and 1px offsets. Red text outlines show up on every screen, plus small icon differences. This round should lighten the font weights and adjust the 1px vertical offsets, mainly on s08 and s11, then fix the icon glyphs."}
